provider_1.provider_capability: Standard GitHub Release asset hosting; assets are immutable on GitHub Releases until deleted or replaced with repository write access. No calendar-based retention lock API.

provider_2.rate_limit_observation: rclone shared client_id throttles directory listing API (files.list) and times out on IPv6; point-to-point transfer with IPv4 bind (rclone copyto --bind 0.0.0.0) succeeded in 2.1s
provider_2.provider_capability: Standard Google Drive cloud object storage; objects persist in folder until explicitly modified/trashed by account owner. No compliance lock or calendar retention API.

retention_assessment.finding: Neither GitHub Releases nor standard Google Drive offers provider-enforced compliance retention locks or calendar horizon APIs. Manufactured expiration dates are removed. Durability is provided by standard provider persistence across two independent provider domains (GitHub and Google Drive).

restoration_verification.key_recovery_note: Unsealed and verified using host macOS Keychain service limen-arca-vault. Off-host independent key recovery remains governed under Wall #320.
